mentions.name: Stained Glass Atlas
mentions.description: A website that documents and maps publicly accessible stained glass locations, so visitors to a new city or town can find where the beautiful stained glass is to go see. Recently added support for countries outside North America; built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS.
mentions.problem: Hard to know where publicly accessible stained glass is when visiting a new city or town.
mentions.audience: People visiting new cities or towns who want to know where to find beautiful, publicly accessible stained glass
mentions.source_excerpt:
Been working on https://www.stainedglassatlas.com.

Trying to document and map as much of the publicly accessible stained glass as possible. The goal being the next time you visit a new city or town, you'll know where all the beautiful stained glass is to go see.
